propositions: DC transport passes empty string assignee directly to pycontribs JIRA.assign_issue, which treats only None (not empty string) as unassign sentinel, causing arbitrary user assignment or JIRAError instead of unassigning
Cloud transport already routes empty/None assignee through unassign_issue; DC transport lacks this equivalent branching logic
outbound_differ produces empty string for cleared assignee (correct); the defect is in DC transport's _assign method failing to normalize empty to None before calling vendor library
mutation tests verify the fix: removing the empty-to-None guard causes 5 of 8 test cases to fail with either JIRAError or arbitrary user assignment
DC must map falsy assignee to None in _assign to match Cloud's bug 85a1 fix and enable proper unassign via vendor PUT /assignee with null payload
